claim_text: IL12RB2 shares a PBC association signal with an NK-cell eQTL and replicates across OneK1K and TenK10K.
direct_support: OneK min default PP.H4=0.998027; min low-prior H4 ratio=0.980618; TenK n=396, default PP.H4=0.997544, low-prior ratio=0.975973.
boundary: Signal sharing does not prove mediation, direction of effect, or mechanism.
results_form: Report all posterior and prior-sensitivity values
discussion_delta: Prioritizes NK cells for allele-aware functional tests
future_test: Edit prioritized haplotype in NK cells and measure allele-specific IL12RB2 and IL12 signaling.

claim_text: FCRL3 shares PBC signals in selected OneK immune contexts and its B-cell axis replicates in TenK10K.
direct_support: OneK robust in B_IN/B_MEM/CD4_NC/NK/NK_R; TenK B_intermediate n=343, default PP.H4=0.991562, low-prior ratio=0.921714.
boundary: Only the compatible B-cell axis received independent resource replication; non-B contexts are secondary.
results_form: Report cell-specific stability and replication separately
discussion_delta: Supports B cells as the primary functional context while retaining other contexts as hypotheses
future_test: Perturb shared haplotype in primary or induced B cells and quantify allele-specific expression and receptor signaling.

claim_text: FCRL3 signal sharing is cell-context dependent.
direct_support: Five OneK contexts pass; CD8_ET reverses; CD8_NC uninformative.
boundary: Cell labels reflect source annotations and cannot be generalized to every activation state.
results_form: Show pass, reversal, and uninformative contexts together
discussion_delta: Explains why cell-type testing must be signal specific
future_test: Replicate secondary contexts in another cohort with matching cell states and source LD.

claim_text: Single-causal screening can misclassify a cell-context signal in a multi-signal locus.
direct_support: FCRL3/CD8_ET ABF PP.H4=0.941339; multi-signal min PP.H4=0.003636 and PP.H3≈0.992.
boundary: One example does not establish that single-causal coloc is generally invalid.
abstract_form: Multi-signal analysis reversed a positive screen
results_form: Report the before/after posterior and CS counts
discussion_delta: Provides a concrete methodological falsification case
conclusion_form: The workflow rejected a misleading context
future_test: Benchmark the gate prospectively across loci with known multiple signals.

claim_text: INAVA was uninformative in the frozen OneK comparison.
direct_support: CD4_NC qTL min P=3.92e-4; default PP.H4=0.0262; low-prior PP.H4=0.00269.
boundary: Weak evidence cannot be interpreted as evidence that INAVA has no role in PBC.
discussion_delta: Shows that a prespecified control was not rescued post hoc
conclusion_form: Omit from conclusion or state as a retained negative control
future_test: Test INAVA in better-powered or disease-relevant cell states without replacing the frozen result.

claim_text: FCRL3–B and IL12RB2–NK are detectable in all five PBC and all five control livers.
direct_support: 10/10 donor detectability for both target–lineage pairs.
boundary: Detectability is not disease specificity or differential expression.
abstract_form: Both pairs were detectable in all donors
discussion_delta: Establishes observability in liver while preserving the inferential ceiling
future_test: Replicate genotype-aware expression in a larger liver cohort.

claim_text: Neither target showed corrected PBC-specific liver enrichment.
boundary: Small sample leaves wide uncertainty; null significance is not proof of no effect.
results_form: Show direction, magnitude, exact P and q
future_test: Increase donor N and model genotype, state, stage, and treatment at donor level.

claim_text: FCRL3 is directionally lower and IL12RB2 directionally higher in PBC liver target gates.
direct_support: Mean log1p CPM differences −0.786335 and +0.329968; direction stable in 10/10 LODO runs.
boundary: Directional estimates are non-significant after correction and cannot be labeled down/upregulation.
discussion_delta: Generates testable tissue hypotheses but no positive tissue claim
conclusion_form: Omit or retain only as boundary
future_test: Larger donor-level study with prespecified effect-scale estimation.

claim_text: The manuscript's contribution is method/replication architecture rather than gene discovery.
direct_support: Cordell 2021, Gjoka 2025, Han 2026, Wang 2026 establish prior genetic/multiomic context; current work adds source-matched cell-QTL LD, multi-signal adjudication, and cross-resource replication.
boundary: Do not claim first FCRL3/IL12RB2 implication, first B-cell localization, or first PBC multiomics.
results_form: Keep novelty out of data-bearing Results except design description
conclusion_form: Replicated axes with a bounded claim ceiling
future_test: External prospective application of the frozen workflow to additional diseases/loci.
